summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on optimizing the process of transferring session data. Currently, one participant sends a format detailing the count of sessions by duration (e.g., >60 seconds, >120 seconds) rather than the raw session data itself.

To improve this, it was suggested that the system should only push truly updated or 'entering' sessions in real-time, which would be more efficient and less redundant. The goal is to provide incremental updates based on live data.

Technical details included discussing how to handle new sessions (`qty_new`), defined as `device_id`s not present in the previous batch.
decisions: Implement a simple daemon service to extract and push open/updated session data in real-time format.
action_items: The participant needs to provide an example of the current data format for review.
